title: CarrierInvoice
description: The ERP's record of one Carrier invoice (Canonical Model document, version 1): what the Carrier claimed, with the result of matching each line against the Carrier cost of its Carrier booking reference. An invoice whose lines all match is Approved on receipt; otherwise it is Received and its other lines wait for Finance. The Carrier's invoice number is unique per Carrier.

total.description: What the Carrier claims in all, without VAT: the sum of the lines.

amount.description: What the Carrier claims for the line.

result.description: What matching found. Matched: the Carrier cost exists for this Carrier, is Open and the amount is within tolerance. PriceMismatch: it exists and is Open but the amount is outside tolerance. UnknownBooking: no Carrier cost with that reference has arrived for this Carrier, which includes a reference of another Carrier. Duplicate: the Carrier cost is already Invoiced.

status.description: Matched: accepted at once at the invoiced amount. ToDecide: waits for Finance.

carrierBookingNumber.description: The Carrier cost the line was matched against; null for an UnknownBooking.

acceptedAmount.description: What the line contributes to the approved amount; null while it waits for Finance.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID API Management created for the Carrier invoice, which the ERP keeps.

status.description: Received while a line is ToDecide, Approved once every line is decided.

approvedAmount.description: The sum of the Matched and Accepted amounts; null until the invoice is Approved.
